author: ETA PRIME
description:
NATIVE Steam PC Gaming on ARM is FINALLY Here! We finally have full, native Steam running on ARM-based handhelds! Valve just dropped the Proton 11 Beta with ARM64 support and FEX emulation built right in. Thanks to the custom Linux distribution RockNix, we can now run PC games natively on devices like the AYN Odin 2 Portal, Ayaneo Pocket S2, and the AYN Thor.
This isn't streaming, and it's not an Android emulator app—this is full Linux Steam running natively on a Snapdragon chip. We're testing out performance, looking at game compatibility, and discussing how this massive step forward is paving the way for Valve’s upcoming Steam Frame VR headset.
